description: A digitless Claude Code permission box (No / Yes) below a tool's output that happens to look like a tabbed settings panel: a ▔ rule over a row of five words ('Home  Plants  Beds  Calendar  Notes'). classify() drops a question under an open /config-style panel, judged by the last ▔ rule on screen; the dialog's own top edge is a ─ rule, so the panel check used to win and report this live ask as idle. A later whole-row ─ rule now marks the panel as history. Pins the question (cursor, highlight on No). Fictional (tmux-rc, 2026-10-11).
